name: threshold_study_20261029
gate: Accuracy gain >=.0015, >=3/4 folds improved, logloss deterioration <=.002. Then freeze and changed-partition accuracy gain >=0, logloss deterioration <=.002. No retuning.
method: Calibration labels belong to outer training only; temporary teachers exclude entire calibration groups; choose bootstrap-median accuracy cutoff on training holdout, shrink logit cutoff toward .5, transfer to full outer-training teacher
caveat: Historical folds have been inspected. Changed partitions check sensitivity, not independent blind validation. Calibration transfer is itself tested by outer grouped validation.
